critical_code_review_comments: NewProjectForm multi-file dropzone: clientDocs accumulator never deduplicates by name; user re-selecting the same file appends duplicates. Minor UX issue.
Backend: 100MB cap is enforced PER FILE, not total. Form description claims '100MB total limit' but backend allows 100MB per uploaded file. Either update copy or sum sizes server-side.
Backend: client_documents accepts ANY extension (no _validate_file call) while brief/roadmap are restricted to PDF/DOCX. Confirm this is intentional (frontend allows pdf/docx/xlsx/png/zip/etc).
DeployedTools.jsx loadTools has no error toast — silent on API failure (only console.error).
